translation.name: Geeshsha Mas'aafaa
translation.englishName: The Holy Bible in the Dawuro language of Ethiopia, Latin script

content: P'awuloosi hewaan shiik'eedda asaa c'addi s'eelliide, «Taanaadan ammaniyaawanttoo, taani hachche gakkanawukka S'oossaa sintsan ta de'uwaa ubbaan tilla wozanaan de'aaddi» yaageedda.
K'eesatuwaa ubbatuwaa kaappuu Hanaanii, P'awuloosa doonaa bak'k'ana mala, Aa matan ek'k'eeddawantta azazeedda.
P'awuloosi he wode Aa, «Laa ha booshinchchaan okkeedda
godaw, S'oossay neena bak'k'ana. Neeni ta bolla higgiyan pirddanaw uttaade, wogay baynnaan taana bak'k'ana mala azazay?» yaageedda.
P'awuloosa matan ek'k'eeddawanttu Aa, «Neeni S'oossaa k'eesatuwaa ubbatuwaa kaappuwaa boray?» yaageeddino.

Hewaappe guyye P'awuloosi, «Taanaadan ammaniyaawanttoo, I k'eesatuwaa ubbatuwaa kaappuwaa gideeddawaa taani erabeykke; ayaw gooppe, ‹Ne gadiyaa mooddiyaawaa bolla iita k'aalaa haasayoppa› geetettiide S'oossaa Mas'aafan s'aafetteedda» yaageedda.

Shin P'awuloosi baggatuu Saduk'aawanatuwaa; baggatuu Parisaawatuwaa gideeddawaa be'iide, «Taanaadan ammaniyaawanttoo, taani Parisaawiyaanne Parisaawiyaa na'aa; ‹Hayk'k'eeddawanttu hayk'uwaappe denddanawantta› gaade taani nashechchaan naagiyaa diraw, unttunttu ta bolla pirddiino» yaagiide, d'ok'k'u ootsiide haasayeedda.
P'awuloosi hewaa yaagina, Parisaawatuwaa giddoninne Saduk'aawanatuwaa giddon walassay kesina, shiik'eedda Asay laaletteedda.
Ayaw gooppe, Saduk'aawanatuu, «Hayk'k'eedda Asay denddenna; kiitanchchaykka ayyaanaykka baawa» yaageeddino; Parisaawatuu k'ay laa"uukka de'iyaawaa ammaniino.

Wolk'k'aama walassay denddeedda; Parisaawatuwaa baggappe Muse higgiyaa tamaarissiyaawanttu denddi ek'k'iide, «Ha bitaniyaa bolla ayinne balaa demmibeykko; aw ayyaanay woy kiitanchchay haasayennan aggena» yaagiide palumetteeddino.
Walassay darina, olaa kaappuu P'awuloosa unttunttu mentsereetsanenttonne gi yayyiide, bare wotaadaratuu wod'd'iide, unttunttu giddoppe Aa ellekka kesiide, barenttu de'iyaasaa afana mala azazeedda.
He k'amma Goday P'awuloosa matan ek'k'iide, «P'awuloosaa, neeni taw Yerusaalamen markkatteeddawaadan, Roomenkka markkattanaw bessee; minna; ayinne baawa» yaageedda.
P'awuloosa Wod'anaw Oosetteedda Mak'k'uwaa
Wonttisa gallassi, Ayihudatuu P'awuloosa wod'ana gakkanaw, meennaadaaninne ushennaadan, c'aak'k'etiide giigetteeddino.
P'awuloosa bolla hewaa mak'k'eteedda asatuu oytamuwaappe dariino.
Unttunttu k'eesatuwaa kaappatuwaakkonne c'imatuwaakko yiide, «Nuuni P'awuloosa wod'ana gakkanaw, ayinne baarennaadan, giigetti utteeddo.

Hewaa diraw, hinttenttunne shiik'eedda Asay P'awuloosabaa geeshshiide biddiyaawaa malatiide, olaa kaappuu Aa hinttenttukko duge wotsana mala oochchite; nuuni I haa shiik'anaappe kasenna Aa wod'anaw giigi utteeddo» yaageeddino.
Shin P'awuloosa michchati na'ay he mak'k'uwaa siseedda wode, biide wotaadaratuu de'iyaasaa geliide, P'awuloosaw odeedda.
P'awuloosi s'eetatuwaa kaappatuwaappe ittuwaa s'eesiide, «Ha na'aa olaa kaappuwaakko afa; ayaw gooppe, olaa kaappoo I odiyaawe de'ee» yaageedda.

Hewaa diraw, s'eetatuwaa kaappuu na'aa olaa kaappuwaakko afiide, «K'asho gollen de'iyaa P'awuloosi, ha na'ay new ayentto odiyaabay de'iyaa diraw, taana barekko s'eesiide, Aa neekko ahanaadan, taana woosseedda» yaageedda.
Olaa kaappuu na'aa kushiyaa oyk'k'iide, dumma gas'aa kessiide, «Neeni taw odanabay ayee?» yaagiide oochcheedda.
Na'ay olaa kaappoo, «Ayihudatuu P'awuloosabaa kaseppe minisi oochchiyaawaa malatiide, neeni shiik'uwaa Aa utissanaadan, neena wontti woossanaw zoretaa k'achcheeddino.

Shin neeni unttunttu giyaawaa sisoppa; ayaw gooppe, oytamuwaappe dariyaa asatuu p'awuloosa wod'ana gakkanaw, k'umaa meennaadaaninne haatsaa ushennaadan, c'aak'k'etiide geemetti uttiide Aa naagiino; neeni giyaawaa sisanaw ha"ikka giigetti uttiide naagiino» yaageedda.
Hewaa diraw, olaa kaappuu na'aa, «Ha yewuwaa neeni taana erisseeddawaa oossinne odoppa» yaagiide azazeeddawaappe guyyiyaan, Aa yeddeedda.
P'awuloosi Gadiyaa Mooddiyaa Filikisa Sintsa Shiik'eedda

Olaa kaappuu s'eetatuwaa kaappatuwaappe laa"uwaa s'eesiide, «K'iisaariyaa baanaw, laa"u s'eetu wotaadaratuwaa, laappun tammu paraa oyk'k'eedda asatuwaanne laa"u s'eetu tooranchchatuwaa k'ammaappe heezzu saatiyaan giigissite;
gadiyaa mooddiyaa Filikisakko P'awuloosa sarotetsaan gatsanaw togissiyaa mehiyaanne giigissite» yaagiide, unttuntta azazeedda.
Olaa kaappuu hawaadan giyaa dabddaabbiyaa s'aafeedda.
«K'alawudeyoosa Luusiyoosappe; gadiyaa mooddiyaa bonchchetteedda Filikisaa! Sarotetsay new gido.
Ayihudatuu ha bitaniyaa oyk'k'iide wod'ana hanishin, Roome katamaa asaa I gideeddawaa eraade, wotaadaratuwaanna gakkaade Aa ashshaad.
Unttunttu Aa ayaw mooteeddinontto eranaw koyaade, duge unttunttu shiik'oo Aa afaad.
Unttunttu barenttu higgiyaabaa I oochcheeddawoo Aa mooteeddawaappe attin, Aa wod'isiyaa woy k'ashissiyaa mooto gidenna.

Unttunttu ha bitaniyaa bolla mak'k'etti utteedda zigirissay taana gakkina, taani he man''iyaan Aa neekko yedda aggaad; Aa mootiyaawanttukka biide, ne sintsan mootana mala odaaddi; saro de'a» yaageedda.
Hewaa diraw, wotaadaratuu azazetteeddawaadankka P'awuloosa akkiide, k'amma Anttip'aas'iriisa gatseeddino.
Wonttisa gallassi aanana baana mala paraa toggo asatuwaa wotsiide, gediyaan biyaawanttu guyye wotaadaratuu de'iyaasaa simmeeddino.
Paraawanttu K'iisaariyaa geliide, dabddaabbiyaa gadiyaa mooddiyaawoo immiide, P'awuloosa Aa sintsa aatseeddino.
Gadiyaa mooddiyaawe dabddaabbiyaa nabbabeeddawaappe guyyiyaan, P'awuloosi hak'a awuraajjaa asentto Aa oochcheedda; Kilk'k'iyaa asaa I gideeddawaa ereedda wode,
«Taani nebaa neena mootiyaawanttu yiyaa wode sisana» yaagiide, wotaadaratuu Heroodisa kawutetsaa gollen Aa naagana mala azazeedda.

footnotes.text: Booshinchchaan okkeedda: Itti uray lo"a malatana mala oosussaa, shin gidenna.
